(9,4) Choose four Dungeon Master Champions.

notes: (19,30) A teleporter appears when the button is pressed, and teleports you in front of the door. Run through it before it closes.
Creatures cannot pass through this teleporter.

(1,14) This room is a good place to train because it contains a Screamer Generator, and Screamers are easy to kill. It is also a unlimited source of food (Screamer Slices), and you have a fountain downstairs.

notes: (13,25) Each of the four alcoves requires one of these four items: a Mirror Of Dawn, a Gold Coin, a Blue Gem and a Bow. Once three items are in place, the door will open. The fourth item will reveal the hidden alcove.
(18,31) Pull the lever, then put any item on ground in the teleporter (do not throw it) so that it gets at (20,33). The door will then open.
You need to press the two buttons at (24,25) and (25,28) to open the wall. The two other buttons are already in the correct state.
A skeleton must walk on the pressure pad to open the wall. Leaving an item on floor will not work.

notes: "Put The Gem Back" puzzle: Use the lever twice to make the chest fall down the pit and close the pit again. Go downstairs from (08,22,10) and grab the chest. Get back upstairs then again upstairs from (08,23,16). Drop the Green Gem at (07,21,12). This will open the door at (08,21,13). Get back downstairs. Another solution is to jump in the pit (or Climb Down with a rope) instead of dropping the Green Gem. Then use the green button to open the door.

Place items on the pressure plates to trigger the fireballs, and quickly move out of their way. Once each pressure plate is triggered, you can walk across safely. If you play with only two champions, place them in front and turn sideways when the fireballs are shot so that they pass behind your champions.

levels.name: Lord Chaos's Lair
notes: (35,41) Lord Chaos cannot be killed by using normal weapons and spells. You must use The Firestaff (completed with the power gem from Level 13) as follows: use War Cry to push Lord Chaos into a corner, block him with Fluxcage all around him except on the square he is standing in, then use the Fuse spell of The Firestaff on Lord Chaos.

The easiest way to Fuse Lord Chaos is to enter the small room at (43,31), close the doors and sleep. Lord Chaos will teleport himself into the room and wake you. You just have to make two fluxcages before you can fuse him.

levels.name: Dragon Lair

entries: Scroll "Only the touch of the proper spell will free the gem and only the Firestaff can possess it."

notes: (49,36) Cast the spell Zo Kath Ra. Use the spell to free the power gem, then use the Firestaff on it to combine them.

Getting out of this room with the complete Firestaff will activate the pressure pad at (49,39), which toggles two walls on level 12 preventing you from going to the upper levels. You can avoid that by throwing the complete Firestaff through the door to the south before stepping on the pressure plate.
